description:
NeuroHire is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, data infrastructure, and data processing systems. This entry-level opportunity is ideal for recent graduates with a strong foundation in computer science, data engineering, database management, and programming.
 The selected candidate will collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, software developers, and analytics teams to build reliable data solutions, manage large datasets, improve data quality, and support data-driven business decisions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows.

 Collect, process, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources.

 Develop and optimize SQL queries for data extraction and transformation.

 Work with relational and non-relational databases to manage structured and unstructured data.

 Build and maintain data warehouses and data processing systems.

 Ensure data accuracy, consistency, quality, and reliability across data pipelines.

 Monitor data workflows, troubleshoot issues, and improve pipeline performance.

 Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineering teams to understand data requirements.

 Support the implementation of automated data processing and integration solutions.

 Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, database structures, and workflows.

 Assist with cloud-based data engineering solutions and infrastructure.

 Follow data security, governance, and engineering best practices.

 Requirements 
 Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 0–1 year of experience in data engineering, database development, or a related technical role.

 Strong understanding of SQL, relational databases, and database management concepts.

 Programming knowledge in Python, Java, or Scala.

 Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline development.

 Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.

 Basic knowledge of data warehousing, data modeling, and database optimization.

 Familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.

 Understanding of data processing, transformation, and integration techniques.

 Knowledge of Git, GitHub, and version control systems.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

 Good written and verbal communication skills.

 Ability to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Academic projects, internships, or hands-on experience in data engineering or database development.

 Familiarity with Apache Spark, Hadoop, or distributed data processing frameworks.

 Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

 Basic knowledge of data pipeline orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.

 Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

 Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

 Exposure to streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka.

 Basic knowledge of data governance, data security, and data quality frameworks.

 Benefits 
 Opportunity to work on real-world data engineering and infrastructure projects.

 Hands-on exposure to data pipelines, cloud platforms, and modern data technologies.

 Collaborative environment with data engineers and technical professionals.

 Opportunities to strengthen programming, database management, and analytical skills.

 Professional development and long-term career growth opportunities.
